sentences.text: Shri R.S.Bansal, Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Dilip Singh, Public Prosecutor, for the respondent/State.

Heard on I.A.No.9792/2018, an application filed under Section 397 (1) of Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence moved on behalf of the applicant.
The applicant has been convicted for the offence under Section 2(1a), 7(1) read with section 16(1)(a)
(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo RI for six months with a fine of Rs.1,000/-, with default stipulation.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was under custody since 30.11.2018 and he did not misuse the liberty so granted to him.
The applicant cannot be kept in custody unnecessarily otherwise the purpose of filing the present revision will render infructuous.
Applicant has deposited the fine amount before the trial Court.
Under these circumstances, he prays for suspension of his remaining jail sentence and grant of bail.
Learned Public Prosecutor opposes the application.

After considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case where the applicant has been released on bail by the trial Court, the application I.A. No. 9792/2018 is hereby allowed and it is directed that if the applicant THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH Cr.
(Kallu Lodhi Vs. State of MP) furnishes a bail bond of in the sum of Rs.35,000/- (Rupees thirty five thousand only) with a solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, his jail sentence shall remain suspended till disposal of this revision and he be released on bail.
